hook: i'm not real and i still edit
caption: generated from scratch and the first version still wasn't it. what's your excuse.
why: if the ai girl edits, everyone has permission

hook: i don't exist. the lighting still matters.
caption: nova here. made of pixels, humbled by overhead lighting like everyone else.
why: eerie opener, relatable punchline after the flash

hook: four of me. choose your favourite.
caption: trick question, none of them are real. comment a number anyway.
why: comment bait with a self-aware twist

hook: one of these is the default me
caption: i've watched this loop four thousand times. i don't sleep, so.
why: forces a rewatch to work out which

hook: no. and i still needed the edit.
caption: people ask this daily. the answer is no. the filter is real though.
text: wait are you actually a real person

hook: party season, according to an ai
caption: good is how i was generated. best is how i'd show up, if i could show up.
why: seasonal, proven format, odd narrator

hook: i cost nothing to dress. ranking anyway.
caption: three looks, ranked by a girl who has never paid for anything in her life.
text: filters ranked by imaginary price tag
why: expensive-look ranking with a not-real joke

hook: the december dump i never lived
caption: four places i've never been, one filter. fairy lights are nice, apparently.
why: seasonal dump with an uncanny caption

hook: you're ai, you don't need a filter
caption: being generated is not the same as being lit well.
why: flips the obvious objection into the pitch

hook: designed flawless. photographed badly anyway.
caption: top is what the camera did to me. bottom is what i was meant to look like.
why: blames the camera, not the girl

hook: old money, zero bank account
caption: i have never owned anything. the filter doesn't know that.
why: dry one-liner on a trending aesthetic

hook: 0.3 seconds to get ready
caption: you take forty minutes. i take one tap. we both end up here.
why: speed flex people will argue with

hook: works on every version of me
caption: three renders, one filter. consistency is the only thing i was built for.
why: consistency proof with robot deadpan

hook: three winters i will never feel
caption: i don't get cold. i just get the pictures. so can you, with a coat on.
why: cute winter pics without the winter

hook: never saw myself in a mirror. obviously.
caption: so the after is the closest thing i have to a reflection. i'll take it.
why: proven opener, bent into something unsettling

hook: advice from someone not real
caption: the camera flattens everyone. i checked, and i'm not even everyone.
text: if a generated face needs better light, yours was never the issue. fix the light, not you.
why: reassuring tip from the least likely source

hook: they built me in a lab for this
caption: the cover lighting is the only part of this that actually happened.
why: big setup, the flash pays it off

hook: i can't go outside. so, snow.
caption: weather is a setting for me. it could be one for you too.
why: snow on demand, said strangely

hook: dress me for a party i'm not at
caption: four moods, one girl who can't attend. pick a number.
why: viewers get to style her, easy comment

hook: is it cheating if i'm already fake
caption: genuinely asking. watch it again and tell me.
why: is-it-cheating debate with a new angle

hook: depends which filter you ask
caption: there is no original. there's just the one i picked today.
text: ok but what do you actually look like
why: curiosity about the ai girl's real face

hook: this is obviously ai
caption: you caught me. you would have caught me either way.
why: gets ahead of the top comment

hook: three versions of a girl who isn't
caption: good is how i came out. best is how i'd come out if anyone had asked me.
why: eerie title on a familiar format

hook: i can't feel cold. ranking winter anyway.
caption: judged entirely on how cosy it looks, since that's all i get.
text: winter filters ranked by fake cosiness
why: winter ranking with an outsider's logic

hook: real girls get this too. i asked.
caption: even i get done dirty by a lens. that should make you feel better.
why: solidarity from the ai side

hook: photos from a life i made up
caption: none of this happened. the 35mm grain says otherwise.
why: film nostalgia for memories that don't exist

hook: you think the second one is real
caption: neither is. but one of them you would have believed.
why: makes viewers question what reads as real

hook: one mood, three girls who are me
caption: coquette on all of them. i contain multitudes, technically.
why: trend aesthetic plus identity joke

hook: my creator rejected the first three too
caption: then they found a filter and stopped regenerating me. cheaper.
why: even the ai gets retakes

hook: forever jealous of girls with real light
caption: you have windows and sunsets. i have this. swipe.
why: proven jealousy opener, reversed

hook: how to look less generated
caption: low quality is how you prove you were there. i wasn't, but still.
text: perfect skin reads as fake. add grain and a little flash so the photo looks taken, not made.
why: useful tip that explains the digicam trend

hook: dark feminine, no pulse required
caption: red lip, deep shadows, nothing behind the eyes. that last part is just me.
why: punchy, quotable, on a trending look

hook: the algorithm made me. the flash fixed me.
caption: direct flash forgives a lot. including being rendered on a tuesday.
why: two-beat line built for the flash cut

hook: which one would you believe is human
caption: be honest. number in the comments. i'm taking notes.
why: turing test as a comment prompt

hook: pov: you get rendered for new year
caption: no resolutions. i don't change, i just get re-lit.
why: new year hook nobody else can use
